_comment: Starting photos/descriptions for the app. Loaded once on server start for any class type or package that has none yet; edits made in the admin panel are never overwritten.

classTypes.name: Bootcamp
classTypes.description: Where fitness meets fun! Perfect for all levels to burn fat, tone up, and build a healthier lifestyle.

classTypes.name: Box
classTypes.description: Master weightlifting, advanced skills, and conditioning. Whether you're competing or just leveling up, this is where you grow.

classTypes.name: Core & Abs
classTypes.description: Build a stronger core, improve stability, and sculpt your abs.

classTypes.name: Open Gym
classTypes.description: Train at your own pace. Your workout, your schedule.

classTypes.name: Mobility
classTypes.description: Improve flexibility, restore joint mobility, and move pain-free while reducing injury risk.

classTypes.name: Gymnastics
classTypes.description: Learn pull-ups, handstands, handstand walks, and bodyweight skills with proper technique.

classTypes.name: Strength & Conditioning
classTypes.description: A high-energy class combining strength and cardio to help you build muscle, burn calories, and improve overall fitness.

classTypes.name: HYROX
classTypes.description: Train for the world's fitness race: running combined with functional stations like rowing, wall balls, and sled work. Build your engine, strength, and race-day confidence.

packages.description: One session, any class. Perfect for trying Carbon or fitting in a workout when it suits you.
One-on-one coaching built around your goals, with a program, technique work, and pace tailored to you.
